Security Stack

Layer Name Description
1 Network Edge Cloudflare Proxy + Cloud Firewalls
2 TLS Termination Caddy auto-HTTPS + Let’s Encrypt
3 Traffic Filtering Rate limiting, bot blocking, scanner blocking
4 Authentication Authelia 2FA (TOTP/WebAuthn) + OIDC bearer tokens
5 Token Validation introspect-proxy OIDC introspection sidecar
6 Network Isolation WireGuard mesh VPN + Docker bridge networks
7 Credential Mgmt Vaultwarden (passwords) + Aegis (TOTP)
